cohort: 100 high-risk pregnant women with a singleton fetus of 32 weeks or more gestational age, whose CTG was performed within 3 days prior to delivery.
finding: Cardiotocography (CTG) is an effective, simple, and cost-effective screening test for evaluating fetal condition, detecting fetal distress, and identifying patients at risk of intrapartum fetal hypoxia, thereby improving perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: CTG is an effective tool for guiding the decision on suitable time and mode of delivery to improve perinatal outcomes through early intervention.
